purpose: Research-only 2D ridge detection, fixed before evaluating the new method
family: Undecimated Gaussian-difference radial frequency partition with monogenic Riesz phase
boundary: reflect padding by six maximum-scale sigmas, then radix-2 periodic FFT

corpus.formula: contrast * exp(-d^2/(2*width^2)) + seeded independent Gaussian noise

metrics.evaluation: Central radius <= 24 pixels; positive pixels have |d| <= 0.75 pixels, negatives |d| >= 3*width; intermediate pixels excluded
metrics.localization: Distance of the strongest response to the true ridge within the central radius, in pixels; first row-major maximum wins
metrics.aggregation: Pool held-out positive and negative pixel counts; also report each case and development separately

promotion_gate.failure_policy: Remain experimental, report failure/inconclusive results; no clinical preset or default activation

numeric_gates.source: immutable float32; FFT/kernel arithmetic float64, outputs float32
